interface.bit_mapping: r[i] requests device i; g[i] grants device i

semantics.reset: active-low synchronous; resetn=0 at a rising edge overrides requests and enters A
semantics.initialization: No power-up state specified; defined behavior begins after a reset clock edge. No initial block.

transitions.A: if r[0], B; else if r[1], C; else if r[2], D; else A

semantics.timing: Moore outputs decode current state and change following a rising edge. Request changes alone do not change grants. Releasing a grant enters A for one cycle before another grant is selected. Higher-priority requests do not preempt an active grant.

numeric.request_and_grant: unsigned three-bit vectors; index 0 is highest priority
numeric.state_encoding: four states encoded with two bits, freely assigned
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow applies
numeric.input_domain: binary inputs; unknown input behavior unspecified

verification.oracle: Independent software-style grant model: idle chooses least-index asserted request; active grant remains until its own request drops; reset clears grant at rising edge
verification.coverage: Exercise all four states with every one of eight request vectors, all reset/request combinations, reset during each grant, retained grants under competing requests, release bubble, and repeated sequences
verification.timing_checks: Check g before and after clock edge to distinguish synchronous reset and Moore output behavior
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite external timeouts and testbench watchdog
verification.success: All comparisons pass and explicit PASS printed; logs retained

specification_ambiguities.issue: Diagram gives identical all-zero conditions for A to A and A to D, and omits D behavior.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use explicit prose: no requests stay in A; device 2 granted only for r=100 in A; D grants g[2] and holds while r[2], otherwise returns A, consistent with B/C.
